capabilities: Export notes to PDF via Pandoc running in a Docker container
Resolve wiki-links into Pandoc citations with auto-derived or front-matter cite keys
Build a BibTeX bibliography from note metadata on the fly
Convert Obsidian callouts to styled LaTeX boxes
Apply Pandoc templates such as Eisvogel with configurable variables
extras: Docker integration was developed on Linux; the README asks Windows and macOS users to report path or permission issues. Installable via BRAT before community-store approval.
motivation: The author built it because shared documents fall apart outside the vault, where linked notes and citations lose their meaning.
problem: Documents shared outside a vault break down: wiki-links are meaningless to readers, embedded files become broken references, and citations look like raw [[Smith 2023]] links instead of bibliography entries.

relations.evidence: passes everything to Pandoc with --citeproc so the final PDF has a proper reference list

summary: Pandoc-based exporter that turns notes into self-contained PDFs, resolving wiki-links into citations with a generated BibTeX bibliography.
